We've Moved!
Celebrating 11 Years and a New Chapter in Exceptional Pet Care
Austin Veterinary Emergency and Specialty Center (AVES) is thrilled to welcome you to our brand-new, state-of-the-art hospital at
7501 N. Capital of Texas Hwy, Building A
, just three miles from our previous location. Our doors are now open, and we can’t wait to show you how this thoughtfully designed facility elevates the experience for pets and their families.
Designed With Pets and Pet Parents in Mind
From the moment you arrive, every detail of our new 45,000-square-foot hospital was planned to make visits smoother, more comfortable, and less stressful. The layout of our lobby, exam spaces, and behind-the-scenes medical areas ensures that our teams can work efficiently while providing compassionate, personalized care.
Expanded Services, Advanced Technology
Our larger facility allows us to grow and enhance the services we offer, welcoming additional board-certified specialists and providing access to the latest veterinary technology. Highlights include:
32 exam rooms for more personalized consultations
9 state-of-the-art surgery suites
Expansive treatment areas for greater capacity of care
In-house, client-facing pharmacy for convenient access to medications
Full diagnostic imaging suite and in-house lab for faster results
Comprehensive AVES Oncology Group, now featuring radiation oncology and the latest radiation therapy treatments
With these enhancements, our team can provide the same compassionate, expert care you’ve come to trust with even greater efficiency and capability.
The Most Veterinary Specialties Under One Roof in Austin
At AVES, collaboration is at the heart of our approach. Our new facility enables us to expand our specialties and grow our team of board-certified doctors, offering unparalleled expertise across:
Emergency & Critical Care (24/7/365)
Anesthesiology
Cardiology (CVCA Cardiac Care for Pets - located at our original site: 7300 Ranch Road 2222, Bldg 5)
Diagnostic Imaging
Internal Medicine
Interventional Endoscopy & Radiology
Nephrourology
Neurology & Neurosurgery
Oncology (Medical & Radiation)
Surgery
This multidisciplinary teamwork ensures every patient benefits from coordinated, comprehensive treatment plans.
Experience the Difference
As we celebrate
11 years of serving Austin pets and their families
, our new location represents the next chapter in AVES’ mission to provide exceptional medicine and compassionate care under one roof. With more space, advanced technology, and expanded services, we’re making it easier than ever for pet parents to access the highest level of veterinary care.
We’re excited to welcome you and your pets to our new home where care, comfort, and expertise come together, now in our largest, most advanced facility yet.
